story_sequence.text: Implement completion or controlled `import-evidence` writes a QA-readable implementation evidence marker with feature, version, run/import id, source refs, changed files or service directories, summary ref, created_at, imported flag, and approved_by when imported.

When Markdown QA has a parseable coverage matrix, `.machine/qa/<feature>.ac-test-matrix.json` preserves the original AC ID, TC ID, layer, command, assertion, and evidence path; parser failure blocks with diagnostics instead of fallback.
QA can resolve a Go + UniApp project runner profile with backend target tests, frontend type-check, miniapp build, and route check commands.
QA distinguishes product_failed, test_failed, runner_admission_blocked, environment_blocked, auth_session_blocked, evidence_binding_missing, coverage_gap, and truth_projection_gap.

The BMTOP `rules-encyclopedia-admin-closure` case is captured as a regression fixture covering missing implementation marker, Markdown matrix fallback, project runner mismatch, unavailable frontend test script, and Docker/testcontainers environment blocker.
